Name: Always fails, to show the breaker
LegacyCronJobName__c: Always fails, to show the breaker (legacy)
Description__c: Throws every time. After three consecutive failures the job suspends itself rather than failing forever.

Name: Batch with a configured scope
Description__c: Launched as a batch; the run stays open until a later heartbeat reconciles it against AsyncApexJob.

Name: Dual-interface scheduler
Description__c: Implements Schedulable AND Batchable, and chooses its own scope size. Proves the adapter enters through Schedulable first.

Name: Legacy scheduler, unchanged
Description__c: An existing Schedulable class called through the adapter with a null SchedulableContext. Nothing about the class changed.

Name: Runnable with parameters
Description__c: Written against the framework. Reads its configuration from the context and reports its own counters into the run record.

Name: Runnable, same class different config
Description__c: The same Apex class backing a second configured job. One class, many schedules.

Name: Shadow mode example
Description__c: Registered in shadow mode: the dispatcher records what it would have started and launches nothing. This is how Wave 2 proves the schedules before any cutover.
